SELECT s.superhero_name 
FROM superhero s 
JOIN colour c1 ON s.eye_colour_id = c1.id AND c1.colour = 'Blue'
JOIN colour c2 ON s.hair_colour_id = c2.id AND c2.colour = 'Brown'
